title: New parking available on Elm Street
body: Starting this Sunday, overflow parking is available one block down on Elm Street. Look for the volunteers with orange vests to guide you in.

title: Building fund update: 68% to goal
body: Thank you for your generosity — we're now 68% of the way to our building fund goal. Join us for a giving update this Sunday after service.

title: Fall small groups sign-up now open
body: Small groups are the best way to grow in community. Sign-ups for the fall semester are open now through the Connect desk or online.
